source.compiler: SI's own data files from the retail CD's InstallShield cabinet (DATA1.CAB), read by HTTP range from archive.org cm-0001-rel (CM0001_rel.iso), each file's MD5 as the cabinet header records it
source.provenance: The CD's volume CM0001_rel was mastered on 6 October 2000, three weeks before the game's release on 27 October: the release-day database. A later European pressing (archive.org cm-0001) agrees on 96.3% of current abilities (39,382 players matched by name and date of birth) and rates 1,866 more players, with a few later transfers (Weah at Marseille rather than Manchester City); it is not the one read. The squads are of the summer of 2000: Figo at Real Madrid, Crespo at Lazio, Batistuta at Roma; Charlton, Manchester City and Ipswich promoted. Four players with a current ability below 0 are unrated and left out. For players matched by name and date of birth, 61.8% of current abilities equal CM 99/00's, which sit 2.6 lower on average (22,544 players, correlation 0.931), and 50.3% equal SI's CM 01/02 3.9.60's, which sit 0.7 higher (35,810 players, correlation 0.924): one scale, so the conversion is CM 01/02's, unchanged.
